title: Extra Life
blurb: Three ascending notes, half a second, pure reward. The 1-up jingle is one of the great pieces of 8-bit design: short enough not to interrupt play, distinctive enough to cut through everything else on screen, and pitched so your brain reads it as gain before you have identified what actually happened. Use it when somebody gets a second chance they did not really earn — a resit, a rematch, a relationship. Streamers wire it to donation alerts and editors save it for comeback moments. Original synthesis, free to use anywhere.
origin: Original 1-up style jingle synthesis in the 8-bit tradition.
